files.README.md:
# Ossory Marina - damage claims log

logbook/claims-YYYY-MM.txt takes one line per claim:

    <date> <berth> "<vessel>" - <summary> - <estimate>

The inspector's notices are kept in notices/. The counter sometimes
re-keys a notice, so the same claim can appear twice on one sheet;
each claim is logged once, in the order first seen, under the date
on the notices sheet.
